summary: QA gate 2 re-gate after the Sprint B fix round: PASS. All four QA-owned findings are fixed and proved by SQL probes in one rolled-back transaction on onion_crm (54/54 re-gate probes). G2-01: a sales EUR item gives below_floor_price [no_price] at any rate; a draft currency change gives below_floor_price [175000.00] or [no_price]; a refused fn_quote_update_draft leaves the draft unchanged; send uses the current floor ([2500.00] after a raise); sales cannot write the price list; the form offers INR/USD only and Rhine defaults to USD. G2-02: Plant's buyer and contact writes affect 0 rows or raise 42501, while sales and accountant still write. G2-03: 17 cross-org parent probes on samples, quotations, quotation_items, inquiries, follow_ups, buyer_contacts and price_list_items are all refused. G2-04: '+ New buyer' makes no buyer row, Save as buyer saves a real country, and quotes and orders agree on export. General checks are green: typecheck, lint, npm test 93/93, ci:tenant-check, next build (33 routes). The fresh mahua_qb2, seeded twice, matches the acceptance counts and is identical after the second run; its schema fingerprint equals onion_crm's; it was dropped. The gate-2 demo flow passes 96/96 with KPI and code lines identical to gate 2. The typecheck and build failure the devs reported was QA's own evidence script labelcheck.ts; QA fixed it with Array.from, and no source was edited. G2-05 (minor, not in this round) is still open. Signed-in UI is still blocked on hosted Supabase.
